verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability documents ad-hoc querying of telemetry with ES|QL, and also with PromQL and KQL. Dedicated ES|QL REST docs cover output formats, filter, time_zone and locale parameters, which shows a documented query language for metrics and logs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of ad-hoc ES|QL analysis on telemetry.

support.subject: As a developer, I can analyze telemetry ad hoc with a documented query language
